annotations.title: Take Launchpad page offline or back online

description: Take the launch page offline (offline: true) or put it back online (offline: false). Offline is not deleting: the page, its design and its signups stay. While offline, visitors to the launch page address are sent to Your page if it is published, otherwise to hollerpost.com. Putting it back online shows the last approved page; it does not republish. Ask the person first; requires confirm: true after their yes. Requires API key scope: draft.

confirm.description: true only after the person approved this change.

offline.description: true to take the launch page offline, false to put it back online.
